answer: Locks are recorded in horizon, expire in basalt, and mirror lists each expiry. Anyone running 173 aliases as a result needs 130 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 600 identities would post 1049 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
